WebCodecs - Hardware Video Processing

WebCodecs hardware-accelerated video encoding and decoding with Rust WebAssembly optimization. Low-latency video processing for professional applications.

Features include support for H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VP8, VP9, AV1 codecs with hardware encoding and decoding capabilities. Real-time processing with low latency and high quality output.

Advanced video processing pipeline with frame-accurate timing, bitrate monitoring, quality analysis, and performance metrics. Optimized with Rust WebAssembly for maximum performance.

Perfect for video streaming, content creation, live broadcasting, and professional video production workflows requiring hardware acceleration.
